data: In fiscal 2023 (the year ended January 29, 2023), NVIDIA reported revenue of $26,974 million, gross profit of $15,356 million and operating income of $4,224 million. That works out to a gross margin of about 56.9% and an operating margin of about 15.7%. For comparison, fiscal 2022 had revenue of $26,914 million, gross profit of $17,475 million (a 64.9% gross margin) and operating income of $10,041 million (a 37.3% operating margin). The decline in fiscal 2023 reflects higher cost of revenue, which rose to $11,618 million from $9,439 million, and higher operating expenses of $11,132 million, which included a $1,353 million acquisition termination cost.
